title: Add migration parity, idempotency, and checksum tests
description:
Add tests and CI guards for migration-first schema management.

Acceptance criteria:
- Fresh empty DB applies all migrations successfully.
- Calling initSchema twice leaves the DB unchanged and applies no duplicate migrations.
- A DB with a pending migration applies only the pending migration.
- Editing an already-applied migration file causes checksum verification to fail closed.
- Legacy adoption/reset path is tested.
- A migrated DB and a fresh DB are compared for schema parity where applicable.
- If a generated schema snapshot is added, CI verifies it matches the schema produced by applying migrations.
close_reason: Parity/idempotency/checksum/legacy tests + generated schema.snapshot.sql with drift guard. Landed in PR #318 (merged).
